comparison.objective: Candidate commissions an industrial damper; record opens a push-and-turn medicine bottle and sorts its contents.
comparison.physical_skill: Both use coupled force and rotation with stabilization, but candidate additionally requires hex-key seating, setscrew release, fine adjustment, relocking, and dynamic validation; record uses cap depression/rotation and sorting.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two constrained physical stops and setting retention. Board record omits setup, scoring, cap-release criterion, sorting specification, spill/loss rules, and run limit.
comparison.reason: The shared push/turn or bimanual primitives are generic; child-resistant-cap opening and sorting do not test damper calibration or energy absorption.
